summary_rationale: AbbVie has executed one of the most successful post-patent-cliff transitions in biopharmaceutical history, growing total net revenues from a $54.32B trough in FY2023 to $61.16B in FY2025 and $49.40B in 9M 2026 (+10.9% YoY) as Skyrizi ($17.56B in FY2025; $15.76B in 9M 2026) and Rinvoq ($8.30B in FY2025; $7.35B in 9M 2026) more than replaced Humira's $16B+ erosion. Operating cash generation remains exceptional at $19.03B in FY2025 ($17.82B FCF) and $14.87B in 9M 2026 ($13.98B FCF), funding a 355% cumulative dividend increase since 2013 alongside heavy R&D and bolt-on M&A. However, KPI health remains PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unqualified PASS due to three structural watchpoints: (1) a leveraged balance sheet whose gross debt rose to $80.90B ($70.13B net debt) and stockholders' deficit deepened to -$4.58B at September 30, 2026 following the $10.6B Apogee acquisition, alongside $27.31B in Skyrizi-dominated contingent consideration liabilities; (2) clinical execution risk highlighted by the $3.51B after-tax emraclidine impairment and lack of an explicit leverage gate in executive compensation; and (3) ongoing IRA Medicare price cuts on Imbruvica (2026) and Vraylar/Linzess (2027) plus Aesthetics filler softness, partially mitigated by the October 29, 2026 D.C. District Court ruling vacating CMS's Round 3 IRA selection of Botox.
